name: tasty-lint
description: Lint Tasty styles: a rule to lint what you change, a page for every tasty/* rule, a tool that runs only the Tasty rules, and a hook that lints each edited file

check.description: Lint files or folders with only the tasty/* rules, as the project's Oxlint or ESLint config sets them (else the recommended preset, or --strict), and print each problem with its rule's page
